PORT.description: Port Documenso listens on - leave as is

DOCUMENSO_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Your email - the admin account, created and verified on first boot so you can sign in without SMTP

DOCUMENSO_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, set on first boot only - copy it from here to sign in, then change it in Documenso

NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public URL of Documenso (signing links, emails, sign-in) - set it to your custom domain after adding one

NEXT_PRIVATE_INTERNAL_WEBAPP_URL.description: How Documenso reaches itself for background jobs and fonts - must use PORT

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Signs session cookies - changing it logs everyone out

NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored secrets such as 2FA keys. BACK IT UP - changing it breaks existing 2FA and stored credentials

NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY.description: Encrypts short-lived tokens - must differ from NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY

NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres on the private network (documents are stored in the database)

NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_TRANSPORT.description: Seal signed documents with the certificate file on the volume

NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PATH.description: Signing certificate - a self-signed one is created here on first boot; replace the file to use your own

NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase of the signing certificate - set before first boot, it must match the .p12 file

NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_SIGNUP.description: Public sign-up is closed; set to false to let teammates register (they need SMTP to verify their email)

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: First boot runs the database migrations before the health check can pass

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT.description: smtp-auth for SMTP, or resend to send over HTTPS with NEXT_PRIVATE_RESEND_API_KEY (works on every Railway plan)

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server for signing invitations and notifications (Railway allows outbound SMTP on Pro only)

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_SECURE.description: true for implicit TLS (port 465), false for STARTTLS (587)

NEXT_PRIVATE_RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key, used when NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT=resend

DOCUMENSO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.description: Set to true to stop Documenso's anonymous usage telemetry (app version and installation ID only)

PGDATA.description: Data subdirectory - keeps Postgres happy on Railway volumes

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Postgres to shut down cleanly on redeploy
